cc:Work.dc:title: Box - RegularStarBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Regular polygon boxes that form a star when closed
![Open box](static/samples/RegularStarBox-2.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes RegularStarBox --n 5 --radius 60 --h 70 --thickness 3 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes RegularStarBox --radius --h --reference
